title: Hosted controls for blocked and failed evidence
summary: A dedicated audit workflow exercises the v0.0.4.72 source at a fixed checkout. It checks early-lane evidence and a real mix of passing, failing and blocked case outcomes on Ubuntu and Windows. The Ubuntu lane also checks named-target preflight behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Early setup and inventory failures report the failed stage and unstarted cases on both public runners.
A failing adoption case is retained alongside passing and blocked outcomes.
The Ubuntu control accepts an available target and rejects the already published v0.0.4 target.

evidence.claim: Ubuntu passed the early-failure and case-result controls, plus the public target preflight.
Windows passed the early-failure and case-result controls using Git Bash.
